response.sql:
WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
), compared AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    timespan,
    avg_fill,
    AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS timespan_avg_fill,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_fills
)
SELECT
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  avg_fill,
  avg_fill - timespan_avg_fill AS above_timespan_average,
  fill_rank
FROM compared
WHERE avg_fill > timespan_avg_fill
  AND fill_rank <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, fill_rank;

assumptions.assumption: Each order is identified by ordersmark and its timespan; the time-in-force average is the mean of the per-order average fills within that timespan. AVG ignores missing fillcount values, while an order with no nonmissing fillcount is excluded by the strict comparison.
